rules.effective_source: A mathematically live source value or exact source descriptor that must cross the chosen operator boundary.
rules.weight: A weight value needed by at least one live product. Residence may reduce movement, but cannot remove the value dependency.
rules.state: Persistent exact state required across a barrier, response latency, timestep, or destination lifetime.
rules.psum: At least one exact accumulator state per simultaneously live destination unless accumulation is moved into a named downstream state with an equivalence proof.
rules.commit: At least one final result/terminal event per semantically produced destination. Zero-skip does not remove a required nonzero or affine-generated destination.
rules.service: cycles >= max(source_issue_bound, weight_port_bound, state_RMW_bound, dependency_bound, completion_bound, memory_bound)
rules.ratio_rule: Only ratio-of-summed cycles on an identical population and resource coordinate is an internal speedup. Official-artifact ratios are external opportunity only.
rules.composition_rule: Mechanisms sharing source issue, memory, or completion cycles are jointly replayed. Their standalone ratios are never multiplied.

evidence_levels.E4: logic-only synthesis or generated-macro component characterization

operators.scope: four H67 bottleneck Conv3x3 operators, S10
operators.source_lower_bound: At least one exact live source descriptor per nonzero source row. The M528 executable coordinate moves 103680000 source-SRAM bytes and its frozen trace contains 92640472 input nonzero bit issues per output block; parent capture cannot remove these source identities.
operators.weight_lower_bound: Every residual/parent product needs its selected 8-bit weight unless already resident. The executable M528 coordinate charges 9069207552 weight-DRAM bytes; this is an implementation ledger value, not a universal mathematical minimum.
operators.state_lower_bound: Every live parent needed after its production point must be stored or forwarded. The admitted 1RW organization is nine 128x128-bit macros = 18432 physical bytes, one 1152-bit/144-byte read-XOR-write access per cycle, plus liveness and queue state.
operators.psum_lower_bound: One Acc24-equivalent state per resident destination/output block until all exact parent and residual contributions retire. Eight resident output-block banks are charged in M528.
operators.commit_lower_bound: Exactly 960000 accumulator-vector commits / 960000 commit cycles on the frozen S10 coordinate; payload bytes remain representation-dependent and are not inferred from bus width.
operators.port_lane_bound: M528 uses row64, B8, CAM64, 128 B/cycle external bandwidth and a synchronous 1RW parent port. Candidate total is bounded by arithmetic issue, mutually exclusive parent read/write service, weight/source movement and commit.
operators.dependency_path: source classification -> exact parent/residual selection -> parent read or RAW forward -> signed product issue -> resident Acc24 update -> liveness completion -> vector commit
operators.work_share: Old pre-decoder activity envelope: bottleneck Conv3x3 is approximately 79.63M of 620.303M cycles (~12.8%). This denominator omits the decoder and is diagnostic only.
operators.adopted_mechanism: C1 exact parent/product capture with dead-write-only 1RW scratch and same-address RAW forward
operators.broken_bound: Removes repeated bit-source product work and dead parent writes; it does not remove effective source identity, live-parent reads/forwards, weight dependency, psum lifetime or final commit.
operators.tax: 213376 B macro-rounded capacity within 245760 B; nine parent macros alone are 78825.2454 um2. Integrated matcher/scheduler/macro PPA is open. Parent scratch component energy improves 38.2283% versus all-write, but this is not C1/system energy.
operators.claim: local exact CPU cycle candidate only

operators.scope: 100 frozen H67 exact-binary FC1 records; no stage3 FC1
operators.source_lower_bound: 829440000 logical input elements include 112213979 active elements; the exact bit-packed source payload is 103680000 bytes. Every active source identity must be consumed or exactly factorized with multiplicity/context metadata.
operators.weight_lower_bound: Each live source needs the corresponding weight vector. Official Prosperity charges identical modeled DRAM traffic of 3.461898240 decimal GB in bit and product modes, while product mode reduces modeled global-buffer traffic from 189.636978432 to 129.064174464 decimal GB.
operators.state_lower_bound: At least one Acc24 destination context per live held context plus descriptor, credit and weight-response state. M481's compact analytical point explicitly budgets a 2816-bit descriptor buffer, two 1R1W banks and 192 lane adders.
operators.psum_lower_bound: Destination partial sums cannot retire until every source assigned to the context and every delayed weight response has completed.
operators.commit_lower_bound: One exact FC1 output per destination before current-batch BN moment formation; a downstream fusion may move but cannot delete this semantic value/barrier dependency.
operators.port_lane_bound: The current candidate coordinate is L96/F2/C16/B2. Service is bounded by 96-lane issue, two-bank response conflicts, held-context availability and terminal completion.
operators.dependency_path: source descriptor -> held-context allocation -> weight request/response -> destination Acc24 RMW -> context terminal -> FC1 result supplied to BN
operators.work_share: 118370114 / 620302905 = 19.0826% in the old pre-decoder opportunity envelope; not a final system denominator.
operators.adopted_mechanism: context-factorized held-weight FC1 candidate (M481); official Prosperity replay is only an external opportunity
operators.broken_bound: Can amortize weight requests and lifecycle overhead across held contexts; cannot beat active-source identity, necessary weight response, destination Acc24 or commit dependencies.
operators.tax: Two 1R1W banks, 192 adders and descriptor/credit state; address-timed macro stalls, full wrapper and matched physical area are open.
operators.evidence_level: E1 internal candidate; E2 external opportunity
operators.claim: supporting candidate, not a frozen internal performance contribution

operators.source_lower_bound: Every nonzero signed source descriptor must be accepted exactly once with source identity, sign/value, destination context and terminal semantics. Static tag elision can remove redundant metadata fields, not the source event itself.
operators.weight_lower_bound: At least one selected weight response per source/destination-bank service unless a separately proven weight reuse relation exists.
operators.state_lower_bound: Shared service still requires live context/scoreboard and Acc24 state. The current C2 context-register plan is 18432 bits before macro/periphery accounting.
operators.psum_lower_bound: One Acc24 state per live destination context; atomic terminal completion must include delayed weight responses.
operators.commit_lower_bound: One exact FC2 result/residual update per produced destination.
operators.port_lane_bound: Peak candidate service is eight signed sources/cycle into eight banks. Equal-service K1x8 is the throughput lower-bound comparator; directed VCS gives K8/K1x8 = 1.0122--1.0392x on four active shapes and 1.0x on zero work.
operators.dependency_path: descriptor accept -> bank/context credit -> weight response -> Acc24 update -> registered release/terminal atomicity -> result drain
operators.work_share: 41413997 / 620302905 = 6.6764% in the old pre-decoder opportunity envelope; not decoder-complete.
operators.adopted_mechanism: C2 shared K8 signed-source fabric with typed terminal/release protocol
operators.broken_bound: Compared with one K1 endpoint it raises source service from 1 to 8/cycle. Against equal-service K1x8 it does not remove source work; the remaining claim must be shared-state area/energy or protocol simplicity.
operators.tax: Shared context/Acc24 and eight-bank weight interface versus eight replicated K1 endpoints. Matched K1/K8/K1x8 DC/STA has not yet produced a result.
operators.claim: functional shared-source fabric; equal-service physical advantage open

operators.scope: H67 fixed T10 phase-decoupled PSN temporal matrix
operators.source_lower_bound: Every coefficient/input term that can change the exact output must be issued. Remaining-budget pruning does not help when skipped terms do not remove a full 32-lane issue group.
operators.weight_lower_bound: The selected temporal coefficients/rank representation must be read at least once per serviced tile or held resident.
operators.state_lower_bound: Per-context phase/slot state, fixed-point accumulation and output framing must survive stalls and release ordering.
operators.psum_lower_bound: Temporal accumulation for each output cannot retire before all exact required phases/terms have arrived.
operators.commit_lower_bound: One exact analog ATLIF/PSN output and frame/terminal event per produced site/channel.
operators.port_lane_bound: M518 r11 admits a directed 96-multiplier-slot fixed-T10 service anchor of 17 issue cycles/tile; clean N1/N4 totals are 29/80 cycles. This is not a full-network trace result.
operators.dependency_path: frame/config admission -> temporal phase issue -> fixed-point accumulate -> phase close -> result beats -> context release
operators.work_share: Global ATLIF total is 128020500 / 620302905 = 20.6384% in the old included-scope envelope, but M518 covers a component service island and cannot inherit the whole share without mapping every ATLIF call.
operators.broken_bound: Can overlap independent phase/context service and choose a trained compact rank; it cannot remove exact Fixed-T10 terms. The ep35 rank3 path is not workload-admitted and matched Fixed/rank3 DC remains blocked/open.
operators.tax: Context FIFO, phase/control state and rank datapath. Old rank3 logic-only area is not a matched current A/B result.
operators.claim: directed protocol/cycle anchor, no admitted performance ratio

operators.source_lower_bound: Every active input event must be read once; each valid tap produces a distinct signed contribution. M705 admits 487063997 active of 2088720000 logical elements and 261090000 packed bytes across three sequences, but no cycle count.
operators.weight_lower_bound: Each active source/tap requires its [Cin,Cout,ky,kx] weight vector. Exact polyphase decomposition changes address/order, not product count.
operators.state_lower_bound: At least current output Acc24 psums until all legal taps arrive. Exact cross-timestep delta additionally requires prior input (870300 bytes in the old single-sequence topology ledger) and either prior output state or a proven downstream-state bridge.
operators.psum_lower_bound: One Acc24-equivalent state per live output destination. Retaining a full prior output costs about 20.215 MiB at INT16 or 30.322 MiB at Acc24 in the existing topology audit.
operators.commit_lower_bound: Every dense ConvTranspose destination must commit because the measured output density is not an admitted zero-output skip. Cout is a multiple of 96, so the 96-lane product-issue lower bound is tight for the current exact A1 arithmetic schedule.
operators.port_lane_bound: Legal tap counts are 4/6/9 by source position and phase service is 4/2/2/1. Product issue at 96 lanes is already at the exact arithmetic lower bound; remaining opportunity is source/tap descriptor movement, state traffic, weight residence or commit fusion.
operators.dependency_path: source coordinate -> legal polyphase tap bundle -> weight vector -> output Acc24 RMW -> all-tap completion -> dense destination commit
operators.work_share: Analytical corrected candidate envelope places decoder at 21.57--22.83%; exact M705 multisequence evidence is payload/density only, so no admitted full-system share/cycle exists.
operators.adopted_mechanism: M522 polyphase mapper + M523 source/tap bundler feeding C2; PDR/EPD performance paths are not admitted
operators.broken_bound: Mapper/bundler avoid inserted-zero materialization and repeated source-descriptor fetch, but do not reduce exact source-tap products, 96-lane arithmetic lower bound, live psums or dense commit.
operators.tax: Mapper logic and bundled descriptors plus dense psum/commit state. PDR is FAIL and may not contribute a ratio; D1 folded-weight numeric equivalence is open.
operators.evidence_level: E2 payload/density plus E3/E4 support blocks; performance below E2

operators.scope: MSSB5 score front through quotient/class/Shiftmax/K-gating core
operators.source_lower_bound: At least one transaction per unique exact score class plus reversible temporal identity. Equal-score quotienting cannot delete independently required K/value identities.
operators.weight_lower_bound: Every live K/value read that contributes to the output remains required unless K is exactly zero or another exact equality is proved.
operators.state_lower_bound: Class multiplicity/temporal mask, FIFO and K-bank state must preserve exact ordering and reversibility.
operators.psum_lower_bound: Weighted attention accumulation must retain sufficient exact state until all admitted classes/K reads retire.
operators.commit_lower_bound: One attention output per live row; RQTB does not remove output projection/commit.
operators.port_lane_bound: On 138 selected rows Fixed/RQTB are 112589/94891 cycles = 1.1865087x; slots fall 62100->34099. Unique-class and independent K-read service form the remaining bound.
operators.dependency_path: score -> equality quotient/class multiplicity -> Shiftmax -> independent K read/gating -> attention accumulation/output
operators.work_share: The measured RQTB core is 0.5889% of its frozen included-scope envelope; modeled envelope effect is 1.000911x. All attention+QK was ~5.185% in another old decomposition, showing projection dominates the quotient core.
operators.broken_bound: Removes duplicate equal-score class/Shiftmax service only; does not remove Q/K projection, unique score classes, independent K/value reads or output.
operators.tax: Class/FIFO/control area +1.2559% in matched logic-only DC; MEMORY_IMPL=0 and no macro-aware energy/Formality.

operators.source_lower_bound: All elements must contribute to current-batch moments. Exact normalization cannot begin until the global moment barrier closes; then each raw element must be replayed or deterministically recomputed.
operators.weight_lower_bound: Per-channel affine gamma/beta and derived mean/invstd must be available once per output element or held in coefficient state.
operators.state_lower_bound: Moment accumulators and 22080 coefficient pairs are unavoidable. Fair one-pass execution stores raw producer output; peak raw retention is 140.625/210.9375/281.25 MiB at 16/24/32 bits.
operators.psum_lower_bound: Moment sums/sumsq must preserve the chosen exact accumulation order; normalized output may stream directly to the consumer.
operators.commit_lower_bound: No separate normalized-tensor commit is required in the fair strong baseline, but each normalized value must still reach ATLIF/residual consumer.
operators.port_lane_bound: At Q24/64 B/cycle the fair fused baseline moves 2626560000 bytes and costs 41048856 local cycles. The 1.499892x number is only versus a weak explicit-normalized-materialization baseline; versus fair strong fused baseline it is 1.0x.
operators.dependency_path: producer/raw write + moments -> global barrier -> coefficient generation -> raw replay -> affine -> direct consumer
operators.work_share: Standalone BN coefficient work is negligible; memory/barrier cost is not independently admitted in the final system denominator.
operators.broken_bound: Already removes normalized write/read. It cannot remove raw information across the current-batch barrier without recomputing the producer.
operators.tax: Very large raw retention plus address-bearing memory; no runtime-affine fixed-point downstream miter or macro PPA.
operators.claim: mandatory baseline, not a novelty/performance contribution

operators.source_lower_bound: Every live event/receptive-field source must be examined by the exact bit-sparse baseline; exact zero inputs can already be suppressed.
operators.weight_lower_bound: All weights selected by live receptive-field sources remain required unless resident/reused.
operators.state_lower_bound: Output psums and spatial scan/coordinate state are required for almost every temporal site.
operators.psum_lower_bound: One accumulator per live output; a zero receptive field at one timestep is insufficient to delete a whole T10 output site.
operators.commit_lower_bound: Whole-temporal zero-site rate is only 0.00387%, so nearly every site still commits.
operators.port_lane_bound: Exact N=0 skip cannot beat source scan/commit lower bounds; even an extreme upper bound is only 1.0617x.
operators.dependency_path: event/source scan -> receptive-field weight issue -> output psum -> temporal-site commit
operators.work_share: 199420620 / 620302905 = 32.1489% in the old pre-decoder included-scope envelope, but there is no surviving new exact mechanism.
operators.broken_bound: No new adopted idea breaks a remaining bound. N=0 patch/tile skip is a measured NO-GO.
operators.tax: Any new catalog/mask adds scan/state cost without enough whole-site zeros.
